prompt: Write tests for the checkout module until it reaches 100% coverage
note: Greenfield mode: an untested feature with an explicit 100% coverage target — enters the sequential flow at intake.

prompt: The payment service already has some tests but coverage is stuck around 60% — analyze the gap and add the missing tests to reach 100%
note: Gap mode: an already-tested feature; the skill must assess current coverage and close the delta to 100%.

prompt: Set up a full test suite for the auth feature: unit, integration and E2E, plus contract tests for its API
note: Type selection across levels including contract tests; the authoring signature of write-tests.

prompt: Add property-based and visual regression tests for the pricing components
note: Selectable additional test types (property-based + visual regression) on a targeted surface.

prompt: Deep-test the checkout flow end to end and find bugs with root-cause analysis
note: Running QA agents against a live app to FIND bugs — not authoring test code toward coverage.

prompt: Diagnose why the cart total is wrong and fix it
note: A single known bug with a written analysis and fix — not building a test suite.

prompt: Our test suite is red — fix the failing tests
note: Repairing existing broken tests, not authoring new tests to raise coverage.

prompt: Review my test file changes before I push
note: Reviewing an existing diff, not generating tests to hit a coverage target.

prompt: Run the test suite and show me the results
note: Just executing the existing suite — a plain command, no authoring or coverage strategy.
Ask which feature/target, whether it is already tested, which test types to author, and confirm the 100% coverage goal.
Ask which module/scope, the current coverage baseline, the target, and which test types to include.
